utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — if you’ve got the latest list, I’ll just go with that and bring whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll pass along what I’ve heard and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes, thank you — Saturday at 10 at the community shed, if I’ve got that right. I’ll be there and happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got Bo set for pickup and drop-off, and Nell ready to help when I’ve sorted the first task. If you’ve confirmed any supplies, tell me and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I haven’t checked the latest supplies yet, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll verify and send you the confirmed list once I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Noah—I’ll wait for the confirmed list before I write anything down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the repair drive and give you the main issue. If you can, send me a firm time window.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks — just tell me what’s left when you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do. I’ll check it and send the main issue.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good — let’s stick to the plan and make sure we bring what we promised.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll handle pickup and bring what we promised. I can do it today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thank you, Sam — that sounds good. Please keep to the original plan, and let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still treating it as rumor until we have a confirmed source in writing. If you’ve got a document or link on the repair drive, send it over and I’ll review it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally fair — I don’t have the written confirmation yet, so I’ll get that first and send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — send the document or link when you have it, and I’ll take a look before we treat it as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like it’s getting off to a good start—people are really pitching in. If I hear the schedule or what they still need, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help a lot, Tess. Please keep it to the set plan and pass along the time and place once it’s final.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll stick to the final time and place and share only that once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s the main thing I’ve been hearing — one clear drop-off spot and a simple sign-up so folks can jump in without fuss. I’ll keep passing it along as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds right to me — one clear drop-off spot and a simple sign-up are exactly the kind of details that keep the repair drive running smoothly. I’ll keep the info precise and make sure the group chat stays updated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s the idea — keep it simple, and I’ll keep ferrying the word around as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the confirmed details on what’s left with the repair drive. I’d rather know for sure before I ask for help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still best right after pickup, from 3:15 to 4:00. Keep it quick and tell me what you need from me for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works — I need you for a quick pickup on parts, and if you can, bring them by 3:15 so I can sort and check the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do that — I’ll bring the parts by 3:15 and keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds right — one clear drop-off spot, one sign-up list, and I’ll keep repeating that same plan to everyone I see.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — I’ll keep the group chat updated that we’re still on and remind everyone to stick to that one clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — one clear drop-off spot, one sign-up list, and I’ll keep spreading that same plan around town.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pick one task: donations, pickup, or sorting. Then give me a time you can do it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m hearing it’s already pulling in a nice crowd—folks are really stepping up. If I catch the schedule or any extra needs, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s not a commitment. Pick one task and give me a time you can do it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d still like us to stick with the first written plan—who’s handling the donations and which schedule we’re using. If Dane can put that in one place, I’ll follow that version.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll put the donations and schedule together in one place and send the first plan over. Just tell me if you want me to use the weekend timing we talked about.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please use the weekend timing we talked about, and keep it in that first written plan. Once it’s sent, I’ll stick to that version.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m still helping with the sorting and tool check. If you’ve heard what they still need, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s lock down one written plan early—who’s handling donations, what’s still needed, and the posted schedule from the drive sheet. If you send the details, I’ll stick to that first version.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can do that — I’ll gather what’s on the drive sheet and keep to the first version.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I can bring the usual patch kit and tackle the fixes, and Kira, if you can help sort parts or do a quick tool check, we’ll keep it moving. I’m flexible on timing, but I can swing by this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not committing yet — do we have the repair drive details in writing, and who’s confirming the parts list? If you’ve got a doc or posted schedule, send it over and I’ll review it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks — please send the confirmed list and sign-off once you have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m glad to hear it’s still moving along—if I catch the schedule or what they still need, I’ll pass it on right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — that would be a huge help. If you get the schedule or the list of what’s still needed, send it my way and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still don’t have a confirmed source, so I’m treating the repair drive as rumor for now. If you send me a document or link, I’ll review it right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — until there’s a document or link, I’ll treat the repair drive as a rumor too and keep it simple. Send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help repeat the same clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — that works for me. I’ll share a confirmed source as soon as I have one, and until then I’ll keep it marked as rumor.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pick one: donations, pickup, or sorting. And tell me exactly when you can do it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sorting — I can do it Saturday afternoon. I’ll keep an ear out and help make the drop-off and sign-up easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Saturday afternoon for sorting is clear — I’ll count on you for that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, so could you remind me what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah — I just need the time and place for the repair drive, plus what kind of fixes we’re covering. Once I’ve got that, I can work it around my shift.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m free from 3:15 to 4:00 right after pickup—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll put you down for 3:15 to 4:00 and send a simple update with the bring-list, timeline, and one clear place for everyone to check details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — keep it simple and I’ll check the update after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s keep it simple: bring the drill, the box of screws, and the tape measure, and we’ll stay with the original plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — just tell me if anything changes once you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’ll check and keep you posted if anything changes, but for now let’s stick to the drill, screws, and tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — send me the time and place, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can handle pickup. I can do it Saturday morning; just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works for me—just give me the time and place, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive if there’s anything I can do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll check the main issue and keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — just let me know where you need me once you’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Opal — I’ll post that we’re still on for the repair drive and keep the group updated if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — that sounds perfect. I’ll keep the details accurate on my end and let you know immediately if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks — I’ll keep the chat updated and double-check the plan stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — if you’ve got the latest drop-off list, I’ll go with that and bring whatever tools are still needed. I may be mixing it up a bit, so I’m happy to follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m still just on pickup and drop-off, so I’m not claiming any tools yet. I’ll follow your lead on the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks — then I’ll stick with the latest list and bring the drill, the box of screws, and the tape measure if that still helps. If anything’s changed, just tell me and I’ll follow along.
